senses.gloss:
तुच् 1. तुच् or 1. तुज्, क्, f., Ved. offspring,
children, propagation; [cf. तोक and तोक्मन्.]
तुच् 2. तुच् in आ-तुच् (q. v.), growing dusk.

तुच्छ तुच्छ, अस्, आ, अम् (probably for तुष),
empty, void, vain, light; small, little, trifling; aban-
doned, deserted; low, mean, insignificant, contemptible;
miserable, poor; worthless; (आ), f. the Indigo plant,
= तुत्था; (अम्), n. chaff; [cf. Lith. tuszcias,
‘empty.’]
—तुच्छ-त्व, अम्, n. emptiness, mean-
ness, inanity, vanity.
—तुच्छ-द्रु, उस्, m. (‘the
sapless tree’), the castor-oil tree, Ricinus Communis.
—तुच्छ-धान्य or तुच्छ-धान्यक, अम्, n.
straw, chaff.
तुच्छक, अस्, आ, अम्, void, empty, &c., = तुच्छ.

तुच्छय, nom. P. तुच्छयति, &c., to make
empty or poor.

तुच्छी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्,
to consider as vain or idle, to despise, contemn.
तुच्छ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. void, empty, vain.
